1.en: Arjuna sees his own family on the other side of the battlefield and completely breaks down. Full anxiety spiral. The whole Gita starts here.
1.hi: Arjun battlefield pe saamne apni hi family dekhta hai aur poora toot jaata hai. Full anxiety mode. Poori Gita yahin se shuru hoti hai.

2.en: Krishna's crash course: you're more than your body, do the work without obsessing over results, keep your mind steady. Read one chapter? Read this.
2.hi: Krishna ka crash course: tum sirf body nahi ho, result ki tension chhodo, mind steady rakho. Ek chapter padhna hai toh ye padho.

3.en: Running from responsibility isn't peace. Do your part, do it for something bigger than yourself, and don't make it all about you.
3.hi: Zimmedari se bhaagna peace nahi hai. Apna part karo, kisi badi cheez ke liye, aur sab apne baare mein mat banao.

4.en: This wisdom is ancient, and Krishna returns whenever the world needs a reset. Work without ego and let wisdom burn away your past.
4.hi: Ye gyaan purana hai, aur jab duniya ko reset chahiye Krishna aate hain. Bina ego kaam karo, gyaan purane karma jala deta hai.

5.en: Quitting versus doing? Doing your work without attachment wins. Find joy inside and outside pleasures lose their grip.
5.hi: Chhodna ya karna? Bina attachment kaam karna jeet-ta hai. Andar khushi dhoondo, bahar ke maze pakad kho dete hain.

6.en: The meditation chapter. Your mind can be your best friend or worst enemy. Balance, practice and patience train it.
6.hi: Meditation wala chapter. Mind tumhara best friend bhi hai aur worst enemy bhi. Balance, practice aur sabr se train hota hai.

7.en: Krishna is the thread running through everything: the taste of water, the light of the sun. Look closer and you'll see him everywhere.
7.hi: Krishna har cheez mein piroya dhaaga hain: paani ka swaad, suraj ki roshni. Dhyaan se dekho, har jagah dikhenge.

8.en: What you think about most is where you end up. Remember the divine always, even at the very end.
8.hi: Jo sabse zyada sochte ho, wahin pahunchte ho. Divine ko hamesha yaad rakho, aakhri pal mein bhi.

9.en: The royal secret: a leaf, a flower or some water offered with love is enough. Turn your whole life into an offering.
9.hi: Raja raaz: pyaar se diya ek patta, phool ya paani kaafi hai. Poori life ko offering bana do.

10.en: Wherever you see brilliance, beauty or power, that's a spark of the divine. Krishna lists his best appearances.
10.hi: Jahan bhi talent, sundarta ya taakat dikhe, woh divine ki chingari hai. Krishna apne best roop ginate hain.

11.en: The big reveal. Arjuna sees Krishna's cosmic form, as bright as a thousand suns, and learns he's just the instrument.
11.hi: Sabse bada reveal. Arjun Krishna ka vishwaroop dekhta hai, hazaar suraj jitna tez, aur samajhta hai woh bas nimitt hai.

12.en: The love chapter. Can't focus? Practise. Can't practise? Serve. Can't serve? Let go of results. There's a path for everyone.
12.hi: Pyaar wala chapter. Focus nahi hota? Practice karo. Woh nahi? Seva karo. Woh bhi nahi? Result chhodo. Sabke liye raasta hai.

13.en: Your body is the field, your soul is the knower. Learn the difference and you see the same divine in everyone.
13.hi: Tumhara body khet hai, aatma jaanne wali. Farak samjho toh sab mein ek hi divine dikhta hai.

14.en: Three energies run your moods: clarity, hustle and laziness. Notice which is in charge, then rise above all three.
14.hi: Teen energies tumhara mood chalati hain: clarity, hustle aur aalas. Dekho kaun in charge hai, phir teeno se upar utho.

15.en: Life is an upside-down tree rooted in the divine. Cut through attachment and find the Supreme Person beyond it all.
15.hi: Zindagi divine mein jadi ulta ped hai. Attachment kaato aur sabse pare Purushottam ko dhoondo.

16.en: Green flags versus red flags of the soul. Lust, anger and greed are the three exits to avoid.
16.hi: Aatma ke green flags versus red flags. Vaasna, gussa aur laalach, teen exits jinse bachna hai.

17.en: You are what you believe. Food, discipline and giving each come in pure, hyped and lazy versions.
17.hi: Tum wahi ho jis pe bharosa karte ho. Khaana, tap aur daan, sab shuddh, hyped aur aalsi version mein aate hain.

18.en: The finale. Do your own work, let go of results, trust the divine completely. Arjuna's confusion is gone. Glow-up complete.
18.hi: Finale. Apna kaam karo, result chhodo, divine pe poora bharosa rakho. Arjun ka confusion gaya. Glow-up complete.
